entity.description: What one CSV row is (Sale, DailySale, Measurement…); names the pages.

columns.description: CSV header in order. A column named date/day is the date; amounts and counts (revenue, quantity, units, price, sales, cost, total, amount, count, value) are measures; the rest are dimensions. Override with dateColumn/measures.

dateColumn.description: The date column, when not called date or day.

measures.description: Numeric columns, when their names do not say so.

scopeColumn.description: Dimension whose values are per-record access scopes (shop, region…): people restricted to scopes see and import only theirs. Default: a dimension named in filters.

atomic.description: A file with any invalid row imports nothing (always true).

errorReport.description: Invalid files get a report of row, column and reason (always true).

compareWithPreviousPeriod.description: KPIs compared with the previous period of equal length.

filters.description: Filters stated in the request (date range, a dimension name).

exportCsv.description: Every chart can be exported as CSV.
